title: fix(app-shell): readable option labels for unlabeled datasource enum selects (objectui#13353)
body:
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01XWGTsmqrtrt1Zqh1ioWqsT

Fixes #13353

## What changed

- `DatasourceResourcePage.tsx` (Setup → Datasources editor): a driver-config JSON Schema `enum` select rendered each raw value (`off`, `safe`) as its option text. The driver-config schema declares no per-option label (triage comment 6359343643: no carrier, no protocol change), so each option's text is now built from its raw value with Studio's existing `humanizeKey` (`metadata-admin/inspectors/json-schema-to-fields.ts`), the same helper `SchemaForm`'s enum selects already use. `off` → "Off", `safe` → "Safe", `read_only` → "Read Only", `read-write` → "Read Write", `fullSync` → "Full Sync". The `SelectItem` value, and therefore what the form saves, stays the raw enum member. No new helper written.
- New test `DatasourceResourcePage.enumOptionLabels-13353.test.tsx`: an `autoMigrate` enum (`off | safe`, no labels) shows "Off" / "Safe"; snake, kebab and camel members read as words; choosing "Safe" and "Full Sync" then creating posts `config.autoMigrate: 'safe'` and `config.syncMode: 'fullSync'`.
- `DatasourceResourcePage.selectPlaceholderLocale-11252.test.tsx`: its CONTROL case expected the closed trigger to read `remote`; it now reads `Remote`.
- `.changeset/13353-datasource-enum-option-labels.md`: patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`. Clause-②: no. Metadata-protocol: none.

## What I ran

- Reproduced first: the new test file on unmodified code → 3 failed of 3 (`expected [ 'off', 'safe' ] to deeply equal [ 'Off', 'Safe' ]`, likewise for the mixed-case enum).
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/ packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/json-schema-to-fields.test.ts` → 8 files, 71 tests passed (all seven `DatasourceResourcePage.*.test.tsx` files plus the `humanizeKey` tests).
- The other tests naming the page or its module: `spec-symbol-parity.test.ts`, `ResourceHistoryPage.rollbackConfirm-13333.test.tsx`, `scripts/__tests__/spec-symbol-ledger-app-shell-7265.test.ts`, plus `product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts` → 4 files, 99 tests passed.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --continue` → 30 of 30 tasks successful.
- `eslint` on the three touched source/test files → 0 errors, 2 warnings, both on lines this PR does not touch (`no-explicit-any` in the `api` helper, `set-state-in-effect` on the load effect).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` → pass; `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` → pass; `pnpm check:new-line-citations` → 0 new citations.

## NOT MEASURED

- The whole `@object-ui/app-shell` suite and the full `pnpm test`: left to CI's sharded run. Locally only the test files that name the page or the helper were run, so a test elsewhere that asserts a datasource enum option's raw text would not have been seen locally.
- No browser check against a live backend; the option text is read from the rendered Radix select in jsdom.
- A declared option label (a future `oneOf`/`const`/`title` or similar carrier) is not read; that is a maintainer ruling, not this card.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
